lines.cap: This dog walked two and a half thousand miles, to get home.
lines.say: This dog walked two and a half thousand miles, to get home.

lines.cap: 1923. A family from Oregon drives across America, with their dog, Bobbie.
lines.say: 1923. A family from Oregon drives across America, with their dog, Bobbie.

lines.cap: At a stop in Indiana, Bobbie gets chased off by other dogs, and disappears.
lines.say: At a stop in Indiana, Bobbie gets chased off by other dogs, and disappears.

lines.cap: They search for days. Then, heartbroken, they drive home without him.
lines.say: They search for days. Then, heartbroken, they drive home without him.

lines.cap: Bobbie starts walking. Across rivers, plains and mountains, in the middle of winter.
lines.say: Bobbie starts walking. Across rivers, plains and mountains, in the middle of winter.

lines.cap: Six months later, a thin, limping dog walks up to their door in Silverton, Oregon.
lines.say: Six months later, a thin, limping dog walks up to their door in Silverton, Oregon.

lines.cap: His paws were worn to the bone. It was Bobbie.
lines.say: His paws were worn to the bone. It was Bobbie.

lines.cap: Later, people along the way wrote in. They had fed him, and let him sleep by their fire.
lines.say: Later, people along the way wrote in. They had fed him, and let him sleep by their fire.

lines.cap: Two and a half thousand miles. Just to come home.
lines.say: Two and a half thousand miles. Just to come home.
